issues.problem: The formula is stated for all p-block elements with no exceptions. It fails for F, which shows no positive oxidation state, so its maximum is not +7. It also fails for O, whose maximum is +2 (in OF2), not +6. A student applying it directly would predict wrong oxidation states for these two common elements.
issues.correction: Maximum oxidation state = group number − 10 for most p-block elements. F (maximum −1, or 0 in F2) and O (maximum +2, in OF2) are exceptions.
